operations.summary: Create the first immutable revision of a line group
operations.summary_zh: 创建线路组首个不可变修订
operations.description: A tenant session manages its own scope; a platform session without target_scope_id manages this control plane's platform scope, and writes naming a tenant scope are refused.
operations.description_zh: 租户会话管理自身作用域；平台会话未指定 target_scope_id 时管理本主控平台作用域，显式指定租户作用域时拒绝写入。

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Tenant credentials may omit this value or repeat their own scope. Platform Bearer credentials omit it to target the platform scope; an explicit tenant scope is allowed only on read or decision operations.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: Must be the single exact quoted value "0".

fields.name: resolved_value
fields.description: When empty the server generates a stable lower-case DNS label; do not enter a domain suffix, port or IP.
fields.description_zh: 留空时由服务端生成稳定的小写 DNS 标签；不要填写域名后缀、端口或 IP。

fields.name: ipv4_resolved_value
fields.description: Record value for IPv4 only; when empty the server generates a stable lower-case DNS label from the line group ID.
fields.description_zh: IPv4 专用解析值；留空时由服务端按线路组 ID 生成稳定的小写 DNS 标签。

fields.name: l2_config_id
fields.description: An active line group in the same scope and region that is not referenced by another L2 configuration; empty means a standalone line group.
fields.description_zh: 同一作用域、同一区域且未引用其他 L2 配置的活动线路组；为空表示独立线路组。

fields.name: failover_mode
fields.description: When a primary IP goes offline its backup IPs are enabled one by one, or all backup IPs are enabled when fewer primary IPs are online than there are backup IPs.
fields.description_zh: 有主IP下线时逐个启用备用IP，或在线主IP数少于备用IP数时启用全部备用IP。

responses.description: Revision 1 created. ETag is a quoted decimal revision.
